findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-close.ts::run close's bracket spawns have no timeouts
findings.title: run close's bracket spawns have no timeouts
findings.disposition_rationale: These are the same subcommands the prose ran with no bound (reconcile, conclude, anchor-run, bundle publish, judge-trail, andon); the bounded-wait rule the invariant names is for forge and tracker waits. An arbitrary timeout could abort a legitimate bundle publish mid-write; only the status probe carries the spec's 30 s bound.

occurrences.title: run close's bracket spawns have no timeouts

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-open.ts::an unreadable pre-check ledger bypasses the envelope conflict refusal and misreports the step
findings.title: an unreadable pre-check ledger bypasses the envelope conflict refusal and misreports the step
findings.action: Report the envelope the locked write left and refuse a conflict after it.
findings.disposition_rationale: The envelope step now runs the locked write first, re-reads the ledger, refuses a conflicting flag when nothing was written, and reports the recorded envelope with steps.envelope ok or skipped from the write itself (test 'envelope reported from the ledger').
